name: GHV Infra Projects Limited
summary: GHV Infra Projects Limited engages in the development of infrastructure facilities in India. The company undertakes roads, bridges, buildings, canals, and irrigation projects; hotels and hospitality, industrial infrastructure, airport infrastructure, and commercial places; roads and rails; and industrial projects, such as steel, power, refinery, petrochemicals, factories. It also engages in solar, wind, thermal, and hydro power projects. The company was formerly known as Sindu Valley Technologies Limited and changed its name to GHV Infra Projects Limited in November 2024.
